notes.title: Retiring WakeUp!
notes.content:
We launched WakeUp! more than two years ago August 2017. While we had a few positive feedbacks from early adopters of the game, most of the respondents were cold or negative. As a result of this trend, we did not invest further into development of the game and also the company shifted its focus away from game development. In absence of our attention and interest of players, we made a decision to retire this game from Steam. This means end of Steam sale for WakeUp!, while the game will remain available though Steam for existing customers. 

Special thanks to all users and followers for your contributions!
